caveats: VAT rates are primary from the European Commission's table of VAT rates applied in EU member countries (Your Europe page, Commission last checked 2026-07-13, retrieved 2026-11-13); the table publishes no effective dates, so each rate's from records the retrieval date.
individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.
Rates and effective dates confirmed on vero.fi: the general rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024 and the reduced rate from 14% to 13.5% on 1 January 2026.
